rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for the shine or luster of a physical object, especially a gem.

example.jyutping: ni1 lap1 zyun3 sek6 ge3 gwong1 zaak6 hou2 leng3

rows.note: Use this for the all-purpose sense of liveliness or vivacity in a person, personality, or conversation.

example.english: They have so much sparkle when they talk, and they really liven up the whole group.
example.traditional: 佢講嘢好有活力，成班人都畀佢帶旺晒。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gong2 je5 hou2 jau5 wut6 lik6 seng4 baan1 jan4 dou1 bei2 keoi5 daai3 wong6 saai3

rows.note: Use this for the fizz or carbonation in a drink, as in a drink having or losing its 氣.

example.english: This soda has lost all its sparkle.
example.jyutping: ni1 bui1 hei3 seoi2 mou5 saai3 hei3 laa3
